plan_title: Para o Brasil Vencer o Atraso (TSE, 76 pages, 9 axes)

policies.title: Major federal budget cut
policies.description: A large, fast cut of federal discretionary and administrative spending to rebalance public accounts.

policies.title: Administrative reform: eliminate at least ten ministries
policies.description: Merge or eliminate at least ten ministries and cut commissioned positions and administrative expenses.

policies.title: Cheaper living costs via tax cuts
policies.description: Cut taxes on food and energy and revise the new consumption-tax reform to lower the standard VAT rate.

policies.title: Resume privatizations and shrink the state
policies.description: Restart the privatization program for federal state-owned companies and reduce state participation in the economy.
policies.title_pt: Retomar privatizações e enxugar o Estado

policies.title: R$ 900 billion infrastructure program
policies.description: R$ 900 billion of infrastructure investment over four years, mostly through concessions and private partnerships; state bank refocused on infrastructure, critical minerals, energy and data centers.
policies.title_pt: Programa de R$ 900 bi em infraestrutura

policies.title: Keep current social programs
policies.description: Maintain the existing cash-transfer and social programs.

policies.title: Classify criminal factions as terrorist organizations; new max-security prisons
policies.description: Legally classify criminal factions as terrorist organizations and build five new federal maximum-security prisons.
policies.title_pt: Facções como organizações terroristas; novos presídios

policies.title: Lower the age of criminal responsibility
policies.description: Lower it from 18 to 16, and to 14 for heinous crimes such as murder, rape and drug trafficking.

policies.title: Harsher criminal penalties
policies.description: Chemical castration for rapists, end of sentence progression for femicide, higher penalties for cell-phone theft.

policies.title: Limit the powers of the Supreme Court
policies.description: Constitutional changes restricting individual (monocratic) decisions and the scope of the Supreme Court.

policies.title: End presidential re-election
policies.description: Constitutional amendment ending re-election for the presidency.

policies.title: Digital economy and data centers
policies.description: Digitalize public services and the economy, and attract data-center and critical-mineral investment.

policies.title: Closer alignment with the US, Argentina and Israel
policies.description: Prioritize relations with the US, Argentina and Israel while keeping trade with China and other partners.
policies.title_pt: Aproximação com EUA, Argentina e Israel

policies.title: Index health, education and pension floors to inflation only
policies.title_pt: Pisos de saúde, educação e aposentadorias corrigidos só pela inflação
policies.description: Unlink the constitutional minimum spending on health and education from revenue, and unlink the pension/BPC floor from real minimum-wage gains; all adjusted by inflation only.

policies.title: Zero illegal deforestation by 2029 through monitoring
policies.title_pt: Desmatamento ilegal zero até 2029 com monitoramento
policies.description: Satellites, artificial intelligence and coordination between agencies to prevent and police illegal deforestation, prioritising the Amazon.

policies.title: Loosen environmental licensing
policies.description: 'Modernize' environmental licensing so rural producers, ranchers and miners can expand activities and exploit mineral resources more easily.
